title: Caverooms
description: This project adds the Backrooms to Minecraft rd-132211 and rd-132328.
body:
# The Caverooms
### About
This mod adds the Backrooms to ancient Minecraft versions. 
You can enter the Backrooms by digging down, at some point, you'll fall right into them.

### Compatibility
This mod was originally created for rd-132211, but it also works on rd-132328.

### Installion
The mod is distributed as a ZIP file. 
To install it using Betacraft:
- Install Betacraft,
- Launch either:
    rd-132211 (pc-132011)
    rd-132328 (pc-132128)
- Open your Betacraft versions folder:
Documents/.betacraft/versions or
AppData/Roaming/.betacraft/versions
- Locate the version's .jar file and open it as a ZIP archive (rename it to .zip from .jar if you have file extensions enabled and open via windows file explorer or use WinRar)
- Delete the META-INF folder
- Copy all files from caverooms.zip into the archive and overwrite
- When re-zipping, make sure you don’t zip the folder itself.
Instead, open the extracted folder and select the contents inside it (com/ and terrain.png), then compress those files directly into a ZIP.
- Once done, launch the game.

To install it using Prism Launcher:

- Install Prism
- Create a new instance and select the rd-132211 game version,
- Go and edit the instance and under version, click 'Add to minecraft.jar', select the zip file
- And launch the game.

### Community
If you want to discuss the mod, report issues, or suggest ideas, you can join [my discord](https://discord.gg/s5aQ7f82r9).
